title: ChainRegistryEntry
description: Chain identity + safety metadata. network_class drives the milestone-1 signing gate: only 'development' chains may sign (ADR-006). Current minor version: 1.1 (additive: chain_family, expected_genesis_hash — ADR-021); 1.0 instances remain valid, absent chain_family means 'evm'.

network_class.description: safety class — signing gates and warnings key off this

chain_family.description: v1.1 additive. Protocol family; only 'evm' entries may appear on EIP-1193-facing wire surfaces (the 900000-band internal ids never leave the registry — ADR-016/ADR-021)

expected_genesis_hash.description: v1.1 additive. Pinned genesis hash for fixed-genesis non-EVM networks; adapters re-verify it live and fail closed on mismatch (ADR-016 §3, ADR-021)

notes.description: safety notes surfaced to the user (e.g. 'value on this chain is real')
